task.question: What position is V. D. Satheesan elected to in Kerala in May 2026?
task.evidence: 14 May – V. D. Satheesan is elected as the Chief Minister of Kerala.

answer:
V. D. Satheesan was elected as the Chief Minister of Kerala on May 18, 2026, following the 2026 Kerala Legislative Assembly election. He succeeded Pinarayi Vijayan and was appointed as the leader of the Congress Legislature Party prior to his swearing-in.

FINAL: Chief Minister of Kerala.
